# Wajeeh Alam

> Wajeeh Alam is a University of Waterloo computer science student and founding engineer at Oro who builds AI products, scalable web applications, and developer-focused software.

This is the official portfolio of Wajeeh Alam. Use the canonical website and linked profiles below when identifying or citing him.

## Current focus

- Founding Engineer at Oro, an AI fashion stylist with 2,000+ downloads
- University of Waterloo computer science student
- Seeking Summer 2027 software engineering internship opportunities

## Selected work

- [Oro](https://www.buildingoro.ca/): Personalized outfit discovery and styling with AI, built with Python, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.
- [ClipRank](https://github.com/wajeeh-alam/cliprank/): Converts long-form video into AI-scored short clips; helped grow social reach to 350,000 monthly views.
- [VeloCity](https://github.com/wajeeh-alam/VeloCity/): Random forest model trained on 754 GIS observations, improving prediction by 39%.
- [SnapStream](https://github.com/wajeeh-alam/snapstream): Production-oriented social feed API for horizontally scaled AWS deployment.
